data.one_liner: Converts dart2js-compiled JavaScript stack traces into readable native Dart stack traces.
data.what_it_does: It maps obfuscated or minified JavaScript stack traces generated by dart2js back to the original Dart source code and line numbers using source maps. This makes debugging web apps compiled from Dart much easier.
use_when: You are debugging a Flutter or Dart web application compiled with dart2js.
You need to translate JS stack traces to original Dart files and line numbers.
avoid_when: You are working exclusively on mobile or desktop native targets where dart2js is not used.
You do not have access to the source maps generated during compilation.
strengths: Seamlessly converts cryptic JS stack traces into readable Dart ones.
Handles mapping for package URIs and dart: SDK libraries.
weaknesses: Requires proper source maps to be generated and provided alongside the stack trace.
Limited utility outside of Dart web environments.
